title: Studio: an unconfigured nav item vanishes from the navigation editor after reload while still counted as a pending draft; publish dialog shows raw type names in zh
body:
domain:ui#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSf5S4Kkc7aL9t5DSd

Filing category: ① product defect (user-visible).
reach: public entry — the console Studio (`/_console/studio/<package>/interfaces` and the 发布 dialog), measured once in a browser (Playwright, zh-CN) on a hosted tenant (`pnpm dev:stack --with-ui`; cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`).
Batch-of: 15 cards filed together from one MCP capability test session (2026-11-11; 6 in cloud, 9 in objectstack).

## Business reason

A maker who adds a navigation entry and reloads before choosing its target loses sight of it, while 变更 still counts a draft they cannot find; the publish dialog then reads half-translated.

## Steps / what happens

1. Studio › 界面 › 导航 ＋ › 对象. A draft entry 「导航项 1」 (`nav_item_1`) appears, toast 「已保存 请假管理 的草稿」, 变更 badge 1.
2. Reload before picking 「链接到对象」. The navigation panel reads 「还没有导航项」; in 编辑 mode 「导航 0 项」. The 变更 badge still shows 1 pending draft. Adding another entry starts again from 「导航项 1」.
3. Open 发布 with drafts of every type staged: section headings render as 「对象 2 · 视图 3 · … · mapping 1 · 流程 2 · seed 1」 and group titles 「MAPPING 1」, 「SEED 1」; the post-publish toast lists lint advisories as raw English rule text (`[security-private-no-readscope] permission set …`) in the zh-CN console.

## Expected

(2) A saved draft entry stays visible in the editor (marked incomplete) until it is configured or removed. (3) Type names and advisories go through the console's i18n.

Reader who acts: the `domain:ui` seat (Studio interfaces editor and publish dialog in `ui/apps/console`).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue studio nav item draft disappears reload` → 7 hits (#29002, #23942, #23163; QA run records), none on this.

Blocked-by: #32654
